content: Aditi Mahajan inquired about upgrading her health insurance to the Health Plus Plus plan with agent Karan Joshi. Karan provided details on increased coverage limits (in-patient up to $300,000, out-patient up to $40,000), premium changes (an increase of $45/month to $465), and alternative therapy coverage ($2,000/year). Aditi decided to proceed with the upgrade and confirmed the deadline to submit the signed renewal form is 04/10/2026 to prevent policy lapse.

action_items: Sign and return the renewal form by 04/10/2026
